newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo industrial output up 13.2 pct in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo industrial output up 13.2 pct in Aug.

text.p: Sao Paulo state's industrial output rose 13.2 percent in August compared to the same period last year, the Sao Paulo state Industries Federation (Fiesp) said in a statement.
August industrial activity, however, dipped 0.1 percent when compared to the previous month.
Industrial sales rose 8.3 percent in August against the same month last year, but fell 3.2 percent when compared to July 1996 figures, it added.
Economists said the sharp increases in sales and output were explained by an unusually poor performance in August last year.
